meaning_en: To reach a specific place or conclusion.
example_en: We will arrive at the station soon.
examples_extra: When you arrive at the airport, take a number ten bus.
We finally arrived at an agreement after hours of discussion.
note_fa: arrive at برای مکان‌های کوچک؛ arrive in برای شهر و کشور.

meaning_en: To reach a city or country.
example_en: They will arrive in London tomorrow.
examples_extra: They arrived in Paris early in the morning.
We arrived in Canada in the middle of winter.
note_fa: arrive in برای شهرها و کشورها (نه at).

meaning_en: To hold something and move it from one place.
example_en: I can carry my own bag.
examples_extra: You wear clothes, but you carry things like bags and umbrellas.
She was carrying a heavy suitcase up the stairs.
note_fa: یعنی حمل کردن؛ با wear فرق دارد: لباس را می‌پوشند، وسایل را حمل می‌کنند.

meaning_en: To take hold of something moving.
example_en: Can you catch the ball?
examples_extra: She threw the ball and he caught it easily.
He ran fast to catch the bus.

meaning_en: To go up something, using hands and feet.
example_en: We like to climb mountains in summer.
examples_extra: They climbed the tall mountain in six hours.
The frightened cat climbed up the tall tree.
note_fa: بالا رفتن؛ climb up و climb down.

meaning_en: To move slowly on hands and knees.
example_en: The baby learned to crawl last month.
examples_extra: The baby crawled across the floor.
Traffic crawled along the motorway.
note_fa: «چهار دست‌وپا رفتن»؛ ترافیک هم crawl می‌کند.

meaning_en: To move very slowly and carefully.
example_en: The car had to creep along in the fog.
examples_extra: The old bus creeps along the road.
Traffic creeps along slowly in the fog.

meaning_en: To move your body to music.
example_en: Let's dance to this song!
examples_extra: They danced until midnight at the wedding.
She loves to dance to pop music.
note_fa: رقصیدن؛ به‌صورت اسم هم هست: a dance.

meaning_en: To waste time; to move slowly.
meaning_fa: وقت تلف کردن، آهسته حرکت کردن
example_en: Don't dawdle, we need to leave now.
examples_extra: Don't dawdle, we need to leave right now.
The children dawdled on the way home from school.
note_fa: یعنی وقت تلف کردن و لفت دادن.

meaning_en: To control a car or other vehicle.
example_en: I drive to work every day.
examples_extra: He drives to work every day.
Learning to drive takes a lot of practice.

meaning_en: To be carried slowly by water or air.
example_en: The boat began to drift out to sea.
examples_extra: The boat dried slowly down the river.
Snow dried against the front door.
note_fa: یعنی به‌آرامی با آب یا باد جابه‌جا شدن.

meaning_en: To drop down suddenly to the ground.
example_en: Be careful not to fall on the ice.
examples_extra: The apple fell from the tree.
Be careful not to fall on the ice.
note_fa: گذشته‌اش fell است؛ با felt (گذشته feel) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To move smoothly and continuously, like water.
example_en: The river flows into the sea.
examples_extra: The river flows slowly through the green valley.
Traffic flowed smoothly after the new road opened.
note_fa: «جاری شدن»؛ برای آب، ترافیک و گفتگو.

meaning_en: To move quickly and lightly up and down.
example_en: The butterfly fluttered its wings.
examples_extra: Colourful butterflies fluttered around the bright garden flowers.
Her heart began to flutter with excitement before the exam.
note_fa: «بال‌بال زدن و تپیدن»؛ برای پروانه و قلب.

meaning_en: To travel in an aircraft.
example_en: We will fly to Paris next week.
examples_extra: We will fly to Paris early tomorrow morning.
Many birds fly south when the cold winter comes.

meaning_en: To pass, often referring to time.
example_en: Time goes by so fast when you are having fun.
examples_extra: Time goes by so quickly.
The years go by so fast.

meaning_en: To move or do something quickly.
example_en: We need to hurry to catch the train.
examples_extra: We must hurry or we'll miss the train.
She will hurry to catch the bus.

meaning_en: Inside a place or container.
example_en: The books are in the bag.
examples_extra: The keys are in the drawer.
She lives in a small village.

meaning_en: To push yourself into the air using your legs.
example_en: The children love to jump in puddles after the rain.
examples_extra: The cat jumped onto the table.
She jumped with joy when she won.

meaning_en: To fail to hit or reach something.
example_en: He threw the ball and missed.
examples_extra: He missed the ball completely.
Try not to miss the target.

meaning_en: to go to a different house or place
example_en: We are going to move next month.
examples_extra: We moved to a new flat last year.
Please move your car; it's blocking mine.
note_fa: حرکت کردن و اسباب‌کشی؛ move house.

meaning_en: The speed at which someone or something moves.
example_en: She walked at a slow pace, enjoying the view.
examples_extra: She walked at a slow pace.
The lesson went at a fast pace.

meaning_en: To give something to someone.
example_en: Can you pass me the salt, please?
examples_extra: Please pass me the salt.
He passed the ball to me.

meaning_en: to walk slowly and heavily.
example_en: The old man plodded along the road.
examples_extra: We plodded home through the mud.
She plodded along the road.
note_fa: به‌سختی و کند راه رفتن؛ plod along.

meaning_en: the speed at which something happens
example_en: The internet download rate is very fast.
examples_extra: The birth rate is falling.
What is the current exchange rate?
note_fa: یعنی «نرخ/میزان»؛ at this rate یعنی با این روند.

meaning_en: To sit on and control a bicycle or horse.
example_en: I love to ride my bike in the park.
examples_extra: We went for a ride in his new car.
The ride to the airport took an hour.
note_fa: go for a ride: گشت‌وگذار با وسیله نقلیه.

meaning_en: To move fast using your legs.
example_en: Children love to run and play.
examples_extra: She runs five kilometres every morning.
The children ran to the park.

meaning_en: To move or do something very quickly.
example_en: Don't rush, take your time.
examples_extra: We rushed to catch the train.
Do not rush your homework.
note_fa: عجله کردن؛ in a rush یعنی عجله داشتن.

meaning_en: To travel on water in a boat.
example_en: We will sail across the lake tomorrow.
examples_extra: They sailed across the lake.
The ship sails at dawn.
note_fa: با قایق/کشتی سفر کردن؛ sail a boat.

meaning_en: How fast something moves.
example_en: The car reached a high speed.
examples_extra: The car was travelling at high speed.
He ran down the hill at full speed.

meaning_en: Mix food or liquid with a spoon.
example_en: Please stir your tea with a spoon.
examples_extra: Stir the hot soup until it boils.
She stirred two sugars into her tea.

meaning_en: To move slowly from side to side.
example_en: The trees swayed gently in the wind.
examples_extra: The trees swayed in the wind.
She swayed to the music.

meaning_en: To change direction suddenly to avoid something.
example_en: The car had to swerve to miss the dog.
examples_extra: He swerved to avoid the dog.
The car swerved suddenly to the left.

meaning_en: To move through water using your body.
example_en: I like to swim in the ocean.
examples_extra: We swim in the sea every day.
She learnt to swim at five.

meaning_en: To steal something.
example_en: Someone tried to take my bag.
examples_extra: Did someone take my bike?
Thieves take wallets and phones.

meaning_en: A system for carrying people or goods.
example_en: Public transport is good in this city.
examples_extra: Public transport is very cheap in this city.
The transport of fresh goods takes many days.

meaning_en: The act of going from one place to another.
example_en: I love to travel to new countries.
examples_extra: Modern air travel is much faster than sea travel.
It is often said that travel broadens the mind.

meaning_en: the speed of something in a given direction
example_en: The velocity of the car was very high.
examples_extra: The racing car reached a high velocity.
Velocity measures speed in a given direction.

meaning_en: To move by putting one foot in front of the other.
example_en: We like to walk in the park.
examples_extra: We always walk to school together every day.
She walks surprisingly fast for her age indeed.
note_fa: راه رفتن؛ go for a walk.

meaning_en: To increase speed or rate.
example_en: The car accelerated quickly onto the highway.
examples_extra: The car accelerated very quickly.
They accelerated the project timeline.

meaning_en: To walk or move at a slow, relaxed pace.
example_en: They ambled along the beach, enjoying the sunset.
examples_extra: They ambled along the beach.
He ambled into the room.

meaning_en: Actions that reverse progress or move backwards.
example_en: The new policy represents several backward steps for equality.
examples_extra: The new law is a backward step.
These changes are backward steps.

meaning_en: To run away suddenly and quickly.
example_en: The deer bolted into the woods when it heard the noise.
examples_extra: The horse bolted when it heard the noise.
The thieves bolted as the alarm rang.

meaning_en: To move swiftly and uncontrollably in a specified direction.
example_en: The car careered off the road into a ditch.
examples_extra: The car careered down the hill.
He careered into the room.
note_fa: با سرعت و بی‌کنترل حرکت کردن.

meaning_en: To pursue someone or something quickly.
example_en: The dog chased the ball across the park.
examples_extra: The dog chased the cat away.
Police quickly chased the thief away.

meaning_en: To move slowly and quietly, often close to the ground.
example_en: The cat crept silently towards the bird in the garden.
examples_extra: Prices have been creeping up since May.
The cat can creep silently upstairs.
note_fa: خزیدن یا آرام حرکت کردن؛ creepy یعنی ترسناک.

meaning_en: To move suddenly and quickly in a specific direction.
example_en: The rabbit darted into the bushes when it heard a noise.
examples_extra: The frightened mouse darted across the floor.
He quickly darted into the crowded shop nearby.

meaning_en: To run or travel somewhere in a great hurry.
example_en: She had to dash to catch her train.
examples_extra: He dashed to the crowded station very quickly.
She quickly dashed off a short note yesterday.

meaning_en: Important actions taken to solve a problem.
example_en: The government took decisive steps to curb inflation.
examples_extra: The new government took decisive steps fast.
Bold, decisive steps were urgently needed then.

meaning_en: To move through the air using wings or an aircraft.
example_en: Birds fly south for the winter.
examples_extra: Birds fly south in winter.
We fly to Paris tomorrow.

meaning_en: The sound or mark made by a foot walking.
example_en: I heard footsteps approaching in the dark hallway.
examples_extra: She heard footsteps behind her.
He followed in his father's footsteps.

meaning_en: To jump on one foot or with both feet together.
example_en: The child hopped excitedly towards the playground.
examples_extra: The rabbit hopped away into the bushes.
She hopped on one foot.

meaning_en: To walk with difficulty because of an injured leg.
example_en: After the fall, he had to limp all the way home.
examples_extra: He walked with a slight limp.
The injured dog had a limp.

meaning_en: To make a sudden, unsteady movement forward or sideways.
example_en: The bus lurched forward, almost making me fall.
examples_extra: The crowded train lurched suddenly to one side.
He lurched forward and grabbed the metal rail.

meaning_en: To follow a winding course or wander aimlessly.
meaning_fa: پرپیچ و خم رفتن، سرگردان بودن
example_en: The river meanders slowly through the valley.
examples_extra: The wide river meanders lazily through the valley.
We meandered slowly through the old town streets.

meaning_en: Go somewhere quickly or briefly.
example_en: I'll just nip to the shop for some milk.
examples_extra: I'll just nip to the shops quickly now.
She quickly nipped out for some fresh milk.

meaning_en: To fall or drop straight down quickly.
example_en: Stock prices plummeted after the economic news.
examples_extra: Company shares plummeted sharply yesterday.
Temperatures will plummet below zero tonight.

meaning_en: To jump or fall quickly and suddenly.
example_en: She took a refreshing plunge into the cold lake.
examples_extra: He plunged into the pool.
Company profits plunged badly last quarter.

meaning_en: To move or appear suddenly and quickly.
example_en: He just popped out for a moment.
examples_extra: He popped into the shop.
She accidentally popped the balloon.

meaning_en: Move or go very fast.
example_en: The ambulance raced to the hospital with its sirens on.
examples_extra: She raced to catch the bus.
My heart raced with sudden fear.
note_fa: فعل: با سرعت رفتن؛ race against time یعنی «با زمان مسابقه دادن».

meaning_en: to increase very quickly and suddenly
meaning_fa: به سرعت بالا رفتن، اوج گرفتن
example_en: Fuel prices rocketed after the supply shortage.
examples_extra: House prices rocketed across the country last year.
Sales rocketed after the advert appeared on television.

meaning_en: To run with quick, light steps.
meaning_fa: تند دویدن، جست و خیز کردن
example_en: The children scampered across the playground excitedly.
examples_extra: A squirrel scampered up the tree with its nut.
The children scampered across the playground to their mother.
note_fa: با قدم‌های تند و سبک دویدن.

meaning_en: To move quickly with short, light steps.
example_en: Mice scurried across the kitchen floor.
examples_extra: Ants scurry across the kitchen counter at night.
Commuters scurry through the station in the rain.
note_fa: با عجله و قدم‌های کوتاه دویدن.

meaning_en: To run with short, quick steps, often to escape.
example_en: The crab scuttled sideways into its hole.
examples_extra: The crab scuttled sideways across the wet sand.
Mice scuttled under the cupboard when the light came on.

meaning_en: To walk in a shy or secretive way.
example_en: He sidled up to the counter to avoid attention.
examples_extra: He sidled up to her.
She sidled through the crowd.

meaning_en: To sit or fall heavily and limply.
example_en: He slumped into the chair, exhausted.
examples_extra: Share prices slumped again yesterday.
He slumped into the chair.
note_fa: دو معنی: سقوط کردن (قیمت)؛ و لم دادن.

meaning_en: Fly high in the air or increase rapidly.
example_en: Eagle soared effortlessly above the mountain peaks.
examples_extra: House prices are soaring again.
Her spirits soared at the news.

meaning_en: To increase in speed; accelerate.
example_en: We need to speed up production to meet demand.
examples_extra: The car sped up quickly.
Exercise can speed up your metabolism.
note_fa: یعنی سرعت گرفتن؛ متضاد slow down.

meaning_en: To walk unsteadily, as if about to fall.
example_en: He staggered out of the bar after too many drinks.
examples_extra: He staggered out of the bar.
She staggered under the heavy load.

meaning_en: In a way that is extremely surprising or shocking.
example_en: The cost of living has risen staggeringly fast.
examples_extra: She did staggeringly well in exams.
The cost was staggeringly high.

meaning_en: To lift and put down one's foot.
example_en: He carefully stepped over the puddle.
examples_extra: She took a step forward.
He stepped onto the stage.

meaning_en: A long, decisive step.
example_en: He walked with a confident stride.
examples_extra: He crossed the room in three strides.
She strides confidently into meetings.

meaning_en: To walk proudly with a stiff, upright posture.
example_en: The peacock strutted across the lawn.
examples_extra: The peacock strutted across the lawn.
He strutted into the room proudly.

meaning_en: To trip or lose balance while walking.
example_en: He stumbled over a loose paving stone.
examples_extra: He stumbled on the uneven pavement.
She stumbled over her words nervously.

meaning_en: Move one foot forward or backward.
example_en: She took a step back, surprised by the sudden noise.
examples_extra: Take a step back from the edge.
Take a step towards the door now.

meaning_en: Deal with difficulties calmly without getting upset.
example_en: She takes all challenges in her stride, never panicking.
examples_extra: She takes problems in her stride.
Take setbacks in your stride.

meaning_en: Move very quickly in a reckless way.
example_en: The car tore down the street, ignoring the speed limit.
examples_extra: He tore down the street.
The car tore past us.

meaning_en: Walk quietly on your toes.
example_en: She had to tiptoe past the sleeping baby.
examples_extra: She tiptoed past the baby.
He tiptoed upstairs very quietly.

meaning_en: Walk unsteadily, as if about to fall.
example_en: The toddler began to totter across the room.
examples_extra: The baby tottered across the room.
She tottered in high heels.

meaning_en: Walk heavily and noisily.
example_en: He heard someone tramp up the stairs.
examples_extra: He tramped through the forest for hours.
The soldiers tramped wearily past the camp.
note_fa: یعنی «سخت و سنگین قدم زدن» یا «ولگرد».

meaning_en: Step heavily on something, causing damage.
example_en: The crowd might trample the flowers in the rush.
examples_extra: Don't trample on the flowers in the garden.
The panicking crowd trampled him underfoot.

meaning_en: Flow in a small, thin stream.
example_en: Water began to trickle from the leaky faucet.
examples_extra: Water trickled down the wall.
Only a trickle of customers came.

meaning_en: Walk slowly and with heavy steps.
example_en: We had to trudge through the deep snow.
examples_extra: We trudged home through the snow.
He trudged up the hill.
note_fa: یعنی «با زحمت و سنگین راه رفتن».

meaning_en: Fall quickly and without control.
example_en: The prices of stocks began to tumble.
examples_extra: House prices tumbled last year.
He tumbled down the stairs.

meaning_en: Never done or known before.
example_en: The company experienced unprecedented growth last quarter.
examples_extra: The floods were unprecedented in living memory.
We face an unprecedented crisis this winter.

meaning_en: to move very quickly.
example_en: The car zipped past us on the highway.
examples_extra: She zipped past on her bike.
Cars zipped along the road.
note_fa: فعل: با سرعت رد شدن؛ zip up یعنی «زیپ را بستن».
